q.t: How many degrees are there in a right angle?
q.e: A right angle is a quarter of a full turn: 360 ÷ 4.

q.t: How many degrees are there in a straight angle?
q.e: A straight angle is half a full turn — the arms form a straight line.

q.t: How many degrees are there in a complete angle (full turn)?
q.e: One whole turn is divided into 360 equal degrees.

q.t: An angle smaller than 90° is called:
q.e: Acute means sharp — a narrow opening.

q.t: An angle between 90° and 180° is called:
q.e: Obtuse means blunt — wider than a square corner.

q.t: Which instrument is used to measure an angle?
q.e: It is marked in degrees from 0° to 180°.

q.t: An angle of 45° is:
q.e: 45° is less than 90°.

q.t: The point where the two arms of an angle meet is called the:
q.e: The vertex is the corner of the angle.

q.t: An angle greater than 180° but less than 360° is called:
q.e: A reflex angle bends back past a straight line.

q.t: How many right angles make a straight angle?
How many degrees is one quarter of a revolution?
Find three quarters of a straight angle (in degrees).
q.e: A quarter of 180° is 45°; three quarters is 135°.

q.t: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 3 o’clock (in degrees)?
q.e: Each hour mark is 360 ÷ 12 = 30° apart. From 12 to 3 is three gaps.

q.t: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 6 o’clock (in degrees)?
q.e: The hands point in opposite directions — a straight line.

q.t: An angle of 200° is:
q.e: It is more than 180°.

q.t: How many minutes (′) make one degree?
q.e: 1° = 60′, just as 1 hour = 60 minutes.

q.t: How many right angles are there in one complete turn?
You face north and turn clockwise to face east. Through what angle do you turn (in degrees)?
q.e: North to east is a quarter turn.

q.t: Find two thirds of a right angle (in degrees).
q.e: A third of 90° is 30°; two thirds is 60°.

q.t: An angle of 135° is:
q.e: It lies between 90° and 180°.

q.t: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 4 o’clock (in degrees)?
q.e: Four gaps of 30°.

q.t: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 2 o’clock (in degrees)?
q.e: Two gaps of 30°.

q.t: Through what angle does the hour hand turn in 1 hour (in degrees)?
q.e: It takes 12 hours for a full turn: 360 ÷ 12.

q.t: Through what angle does the minute hand turn in 10 minutes (in degrees)?
q.e: It turns 360° in 60 minutes — 6° a minute. 10 × 6 = 60.

q.t: You face north and turn clockwise to face south-west. Through what angle do you turn (in degrees)?
q.e: North to south is 180°, and south-west is another 45° further.

q.t: How many degrees is one twelfth of a revolution?

How many degrees are there in 7 right angles?
At 5 o’clock, what is the REFLEX angle between the hands (in degrees)?
q.e: The smaller angle is 5 × 30 = 150°. The reflex angle is the rest of the turn: 360 − 150.

q.t: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 2:30 (in degrees)?
q.e: The minute hand is at 6 (180°). The hour hand is halfway from 2 to 3: 60 + 15 = 75°. Difference 105°.

q.t: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 9:30 (in degrees)?
q.e: Minute hand at 180°. Hour hand halfway from 9 to 10: 270 + 15 = 285°. Difference 105°.

q.t: Through what angle does the hour hand turn between 3:00 and 3:40 (in degrees)?
q.e: It turns 30° in an hour, so in 40 minutes it turns two thirds of that.

q.t: How many minutes does the minute hand take to turn through 150°?
q.e: It turns 6° each minute: 150 ÷ 6.

q.t: What is the angle between the directions north and north-east (in degrees)?
q.e: North-east is exactly halfway between north and east: half of 90°.

q.t: You face east and turn 135° clockwise. Which direction do you now face?
q.e: 90° clockwise from east is south; another 45° reaches south-west.

q.t: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 4:20 (in degrees)?
q.e: Minute hand at 4 (120°). Hour hand one third of the way from 4 to 5: 120 + 10 = 130°. Difference 10°.

q.t: Find two fifths of a complete angle (in degrees).
q.e: One fifth of 360° is 72°; two fifths is 144°.

q.t: Three equal angles fit exactly round a point. Find each (in degrees).
q.e: They share the full turn equally: 360 ÷ 3.

q.t: How many times are the hands of a clock at right angles between 12 noon and 12 midnight?
q.e: The minute hand gains a full lap on the hour hand 11 times in 12 hours, and in each lap they are at right angles twice: 11 × 2 = 22.
